title: Same Tree
prompt:
Return whether two binary trees are identical in both structure and values.

**Example**: `[1,2,3]` and `[1,2,3]` → `true`; `[1,2]` and `[1,null,2]` → `false`.

Parallel recursion: compare the two roots, then recurse on left-pair and right-pair together.
hints: Both null → equal. Exactly one null, or differing values → not equal.
Otherwise recurse: left subtrees must match AND right subtrees must match.

solution.explanation: O(n), walking both trees in lockstep. The three-line base case covers all mismatches (structure via the null checks, values via `p.val != q.val`); the recursion just demands both sides agree. This `same` check is the building block of Subtree of Another Tree.
